meta.name: blog-post-writer
meta.description: 将零散的想法或原始文章转化为指定风格的公众号文章。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将零散想法转化为指定风格的公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速将想法整理成公众号文章
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered ideas into WeChat articles in your style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn ideas into WeChat articles

howto.what: 将你零散的想法或原始文章，自动改写成特定风格的公众号文章，并生成至少三张配图，最后保存为Markdown文件。
howto.when: 当你提供零散想法、要点、原始文章或参考链接，并希望将其转化为公众号文章时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇公众号文章，主题是放弃旧工具换新工具。
say.note: 会生成一篇观点体文章，包含标题、正文和配图。

say.text: 把这段关于AI工具的想法改写成公众号风格。
say.note: 会按照指定风格组织内容，并生成配图。

say.text: 根据这篇文章，写一篇工具推荐类的公众号文章。
say.note: 会提取核心观点，生成符合模板的文章。

howto.what_en: Transform your scattered ideas or raw articles into WeChat public account articles in a specific style, generate at least three images, and save as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide scattered ideas, key points, raw articles, or reference links and want them turned into a WeChat public account article.

say_en.text: Write a WeChat article about abandoning old tools for new ones.
say_en.note: Generates an opinion-style article with title, body, and images.

say_en.text: Rewrite this AI tool idea into WeChat public account style.
say_en.note: Organizes content in the specified style and generates images.

say_en.text: Based on this article, write a tool recommendation WeChat article.
say_en.note: Extracts key points and generates an article following the template.
